description: This file defines several interfaces related to streaming grains in a testing context, including producer, consumer, inline consumer, and a grain with generic methods, within the namespace 'UnitTests.GrainInterfaces'.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Sets the grain to become a producer with specified stream ID, namespace, and provider.

methods.name: StartPeriodicProducing
methods.description: Starts periodic production of stream data.

methods.name: StopPeriodicProducing
methods.description: Stops periodic production of stream data.

methods.name: GetNumberProduced
methods.description: Retrieves the number of items produced.

methods.name: ClearNumberProduced
methods.description: Clears the count of produced items.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Sets the grain to become a consumer with specified stream ID, namespace, and provider.

methods.name: GetNumberConsumed
methods.description: Retrieves the number of items consumed.

methods.name: ValueTaskMethod
methods.description: A method returning a ValueTask<int>, optionally using cache based on the boolean parameter.
